# Greenland Sea primary production fixture — attribution

`greenland_pp.tsv` is the **entire** published PANGAEA textfile (6,988 bytes, 12 rows),
byte for byte. `greenland_pp_meta.jsonld` keeps eight keys of the dataset's JSON-LD,
values verbatim.

**Source:** PANGAEA, <https://doi.org/10.1594/PANGAEA.965985> — the full citation is the
`Citation:` line inside the file's comment block.
**Licence:** CC-BY-4.0 — <https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/>.
